title: validateRpg does not bound the score var from below — one dec_var action can make a save permanently unloadable
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

The check belongs in src/validate/rpg_foundation_validator.ts (the score checks at ~1120-1132 only assert max_score is REACHABLE, never that score cannot leave [0, max_score]), which is outside my ownership — validator subsystem. `dec_var` has no zero floor in src/core/effects.ts, also not mine. Nothing in src/rpg/** can correctly fix this: clamping at the reducer would silently rewrite authored content, and the RPG runner is not the right place to enforce a content-validity rule.
